title: Cozy Wildlife Journal
description: Travel across the world documenting hundreds of unique animals and complete your Wildlife Journal!
body:
# Welcome to Cozy Wildlife Journal
A relaxing exploration and wildlife-focused modpack built around discovery, adventure, and documenting the natural world (in some cases even the unnatural).
![wildlife journal banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/641092326e456a82933f647c47b082670fecfa98.png)
### Your goal is simple:
Explor the world, find animals, and complete your journal!

![photo 1](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/65c61b2610881bc265a6780ae1d7d7f017b15a2b_0.webp)
Travel through forests, mountains, rivers, oceans, caves, snowy landscapes, and more as you search for hundreds of different creatures from all around your world. From tiny insects and colorful birds to aquatic life and rare wildlife, every new discovery brings you closer to completing your journal.

Unlike traditional progression-heavy modpacks, Cozy Wildlife Journal focuses on relaxing exploration, quest-based wildlife discovery and immersive atmosphere.

![photo 2](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f7d66356d797922acbda96b55c0408b2ecfb17a8_0.webp)
### Exploration Rewards:
Completing quests reward you with special themed supply packs filled with useful resources, food, materials, and eploration tools to help you continue your adventure.
### Final Reward:
Players who fully complete the Wildlife Journal will unlock a special decorative trophy to commemorate their journey and dedication.

![photo 3](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/dcbe1403302a23c5b83e6819c00ca8150d075769_0.webp)
Perfect for players who enjoy cozy Minecraft experiences, exploration-focused gameplay, and relaxing quest progression.

Play solo or with friends. You can also use our code "**withrage**" for **25%** of off your new **Bisect Hosting** server!

![bisect hosting banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/30070cd112859f8c573fe30bb1ed4a89a6711b2d_0.webp)
### Issues & Feedback:
If you find any issues, please report them on our **Discord** server. The same goes for suggestions!
